title: Past simple, past continuous, past perfect - Narrative tenses mastery

options.answer: When I arrived, she was cooking dinner.
When I arrived, she cooked dinner.
When I was arriving, she cooked dinner.

explanation.en: Past continuous shows an ongoing action interrupted by a past simple action. 'Was cooking' was in progress when 'I arrived' happened.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее длительное время показывает продолжающееся действие, прерванное действием в простом прошедшем времени. 'Was cooking' происходило, когда случилось 'I arrived'.
explanation.uz: Past continuous davom etayotgan harakatni ko'rsatadi, uni past simple harakat to'xtatgan. 'Was cooking' davom etayotgan edi, 'I arrived' sodir bo'lganda.

options.answer: He had finished his work before he went home.
He finished his work before he had went home.
He had finish his work before he went home.

explanation.en: Past perfect 'had finished' shows an action completed before another past action 'went home'. Past perfect uses 'had + past participle'.
explanation.ru: Past perfect 'had finished' показывает действие, завершенное до другого прошедшего действия 'went home'. Past perfect использует 'had + причастие прошедшего времени'.
explanation.uz: Past perfect 'had finished' boshqa o'tmish harakat 'went home'dan oldin tugallangan harakatni ko'rsatadi. Past perfect 'had + past participle' ishlatadi.

options.answer: While she studied, her phone was ringing.
While she was studying, her phone rang.
While she had studied, her phone rang.

explanation.en: Past continuous 'was studying' shows ongoing action, interrupted by past simple 'phone rang'. This is the correct pattern for interruption.
explanation.ru: Past continuous 'was studying' показывает продолжающееся действие, прерванное past simple 'phone rang'. Это правильная модель для прерывания.
explanation.uz: Past continuous 'was studying' davom etayotgan harakatni ko'rsatadi, uni past simple 'phone rang' to'xtatgan. Bu to'xtatish uchun to'g'ri model.

options.answer: They played football yesterday at 3 PM.
They were playing football yesterday at 3 PM.
They had played football yesterday at 3 PM.

explanation.en: Past continuous 'were playing' is correct for an action in progress at a specific time in the past (3 PM yesterday).
explanation.ru: Past continuous 'were playing' правильно для действия, происходившего в определенное время в прошлом (вчера в 3 часа).
explanation.uz: Past continuous 'were playing' o'tmishda aniq vaqtda (kecha soat 3da) davom etgan harakat uchun to'g'ri.

options.answer: After she had eaten lunch, she felt better.
After she ate lunch, she had felt better.
After she was eating lunch, she felt better.

explanation.en: Past perfect 'had eaten' shows the first action was completed before the second action 'felt better' in past simple.
explanation.ru: Past perfect 'had eaten' показывает, что первое действие было завершено до второго действия 'felt better' в past simple.
explanation.uz: Past perfect 'had eaten' birinchi harakat ikkinchi harakat 'felt better' (past simple)dan oldin tugallanganini ko'rsatadi.

options.answer: When the train arrived, we had been waiting for an hour.
When the train was arriving, we waited for an hour.
When the train arrived, we were waiting for an hour.

explanation.en: Past continuous 'were waiting' shows the ongoing action that was interrupted when the train arrived (past simple).
explanation.ru: Past continuous 'were waiting' показывает продолжающееся действие, которое было прервано, когда прибыл поезд (past simple).
explanation.uz: Past continuous 'were waiting' poyezd kelganda (past simple) to'xtatilgan davom etayotgan harakatni ko'rsatadi.

options.answer: She lived in Paris before she moved to London.
She had lived in Paris before she moved to London.
She was living in Paris before she moved to London.

explanation.en: Past perfect 'had lived' shows the earlier action completed before the later action 'moved' in the sequence of past events.
explanation.ru: Past perfect 'had lived' показывает более раннее действие, завершенное до более позднего действия 'moved' в последовательности прошедших событий.
explanation.uz: Past perfect 'had lived' o'tmish voqealar ketma-ketligida keyingi harakat 'moved'dan oldin tugallangan avvalgi harakatni ko'rsatadi.

options.answer: At 8 o'clock last night, I watched TV.
At 8 o'clock last night, I had watched TV.
At 8 o'clock last night, I have watched TV.

explanation.en: Past simple 'watched' is correct for a completed action at a specific time in the past (8 o'clock last night).
explanation.ru: Past simple 'watched' правильно для завершенного действия в определенное время в прошлом (вчера в 8 часов вечера).
explanation.uz: Past simple 'watched' o'tmishda aniq vaqtda (kecha soat 8da) tugallangan harakat uchun to'g'ri.

options.answer: By the time we got to the cinema, the film started.
By the time we got to the cinema, the film had started.
By the time we got to the cinema, the film was starting.

explanation.en: Past perfect 'had started' shows the film began before we arrived. 'By the time' signals past perfect for the earlier action.
explanation.ru: Past perfect 'had started' показывает, что фильм начался до нашего прибытия. 'By the time' сигнализирует past perfect для более раннего действия.
explanation.uz: Past perfect 'had started' film biz kelishdan oldin boshlanganini ko'rsatadi. 'By the time' avvalgi harakat uchun past perfect belgisini beradi.

options.answer: Yesterday I was walking to work when it started to rain.
Yesterday I walked to work when it was starting to rain.
Yesterday I had walked to work when it started to rain.

explanation.en: Past continuous 'was walking' shows ongoing action interrupted by past simple 'started to rain'. This is the standard interruption pattern.
explanation.ru: Past continuous 'was walking' показывает продолжающееся действие, прерванное past simple 'started to rain'. Это стандартная модель прерывания.
explanation.uz: Past continuous 'was walking' davom etayotgan harakatni ko'rsatadi, uni past simple 'started to rain' to'xtatgan. Bu standart to'xtatish modeli.
